implementation_gate.name: stage2_joint_grpo_persistent_episode_v2_random_start_implementation
implementation_gate.scope: reproducible randomized training starts, frozen S5-S9 scenario-window closure, observed-window retry tightening, partial-visit continuation, v6 online artifacts, v2 A/B binding, focused regression, and one bounded real CUDA smoke

random_start_semantics.ready_state: capture history first; before history readiness do not query the mutating scenario summary; afterwards capture the summary exactly once per decision state
random_start_semantics.draw: at the first jointly ready state, consume exactly one inclusive torch.randint call from the shared training generator, including when the upper bound is zero
random_start_semantics.wait: advance with route-following warm-up actions until t_ready plus the sampled offset while checking the sticky scenario-window predicate and natural termination every step
random_start_semantics.accepted_segment: after the randomized start, reuse the same live environment for up to ten consecutive rollout groups and execute exactly one selected env.step per group
random_start_semantics.validation: fixed validation retains the historical earliest-ready start and never consumes a training offset draw

retry_and_resume.late_target: on window closure or natural termination before the target, keep the bucket and visit cursor fixed and tighten only the next live episode to the observed last-open offset
retry_and_resume.temporary_bound_reset: clear the temporary bound immediately after the first accepted rollout in the retrying episode
retry_and_resume.partial_visit: never roll back completed rollout groups or optimizer epochs when a live segment ends
retry_and_resume.checkpoint: save only after closing the live environment; generator state, bucket counters, cursor, and visit progress reproduce the next offset and diffusion-noise sequence
retry_and_resume.legacy_resume: v1/v5 artifacts remain read-only but fail the exact v2/v6 resume contract

focused_regression.command: HOME=/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PYTHONPATH /home/kong/anaconda3/envs/meta_drive/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_online.py tests/test_compare_grpo_stability.py tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_a.py tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_b.py tests/test_plot_grpo.py tests/test_run_bev_joint_grpo_launcher.py tests/test_bev_reward_comparison.py -q
covered: inclusive offset sampling and the t_ready 190/191 cap boundary
zero-upper-bound RNG consumption and uninterrupted-versus-resumed offset/noise equality
all five frozen scenario-window close predicates
no scenario-summary read before history readiness and one summary read per later state
one draw per live episode, exact t_ready plus offset start, and ten consecutive groups in one fake environment
natural-terminal and window-close retry tightening without false three-empty failure
partial-visit continuation, uninformative execution, and fixed-validation earliest-ready behavior
v6 config/report, exact v2 checkpoint contract, and strict v2 A/B fairness binding
core clipped GRPO, plotting, launcher, and legacy reward-evaluator compatibility

cuda_random_start_smoke.episode_reuse_evidence: the accepted S5 bucket episode produced rollout groups 1 and 2 at consecutive training environment steps 98 and 99 from one reset

configuration_note.operator_consequence: a direct launch with the main YAML performs ten optimizer epochs per informative rollout; the future paired A/B must use explicit E1 and E4 configs

maintenance_note.impact: the repository AGENTS index points to an absent Phase 6 file; the frozen machine-readable project plan and current Stage 2 contracts were used as authority

next_hard_gate: Keep strict_stage1_v2_run3_qualification as the formal gate. The diagnostic run_8 through run_13 A/B may run only in a separate frozen-code training thread with explicit E1/E4 configs and the exact v2 collection contract.
